title: Semiconductor manufacturing ontology
description: Portable semiconductor-manufacturing semantics imported from the supplied Lattice ontology.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Ontology
metadata:
  name: semiconductor-manufacturing
  title: Semiconductor Manufacturing Ontology
  description: Fundamental entities and relationships shared across Semiconductor Manufacturing decision contracts.
  version: 0.1.0
  source:
    system: lattice
    sourceId: semiconductor-manufacturing-ontology
    sourceVersion: 0.1.0
    sourceDigest: sha256:31f376514167d369393ca3c15fba164fe73f3f349312d49bb7c65252c724d21e
spec:
  types:
    - id: wafer
      label: Wafer
      description: A governed silicon wafer moving through the fab.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0
      properties:
        - id: wafer.wafer_id
          label: Wafer Id
          description: Stable wafer identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/0
        - id: wafer.lot_id
          label: Lot Id
          description: Parent lot identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/1
        - id: wafer.wafer_diameter_mm
          label: Wafer Diameter Mm
          description: Wafer diameter in millimeters.
          dataType: integer
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/2
        - id: wafer.technology_node
          label: Technology Node
          description: Process node such as 28nm, 14nm, 7nm, 5nm, 3nm.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/3
        - id: wafer.started_at
          label: Started At
          description: Time the wafer was started.
          dataType: datetime
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/4
        - id: wafer.completed_at
          label: Completed At
          description: Time the wafer completed processing.
          dataType: datetime
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/5
    - id: lot
      label: Lot
      description: A production lot grouping wafers for a given product and recipe.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1
      properties:
        - id: lot.lot_id
          label: Lot Id
          description: Stable lot identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/0
        - id: lot.product_code
          label: Product Code
          description: Device product code.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/1
        - id: lot.recipe
          label: Recipe
          description: Process recipe identifier or version.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/2
        - id: lot.wafer_count
          label: Wafer Count
          description: Number of wafers in the lot.
          dataType: integer
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/3
        - id: lot.lot_status
          label: Lot Status
          description: Queue, in-process, hold, complete, scrapped.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/4
        - id: lot.customer
          label: Customer
          description: Customer or foundry program identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/5
    - id: process_step
      label: Process Step
      description: A governed unit of fab processing such as lithography, etch, or implant.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2
      properties:
        - id: process_step.step_id
          label: Process Step Id
          description: Stable identifier of the process step.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/0
        - id: process_step.process_name
          label: Process Name
          description: Lithography, etch, CMP, implant, deposition, etc.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/1
        - id: process_step.tool_id
          label: Tool Id
          description: Tool that executed the step.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/2
        - id: process_step.started_at
          label: Started At
          description: Step start time.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/3
        - id: process_step.completed_at
          label: Completed At
          description: Step end time.
          dataType: datetime
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/4
        - id: process_step.operator
          label: Operator
          description: Operator or handler.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/5
        - id: process_step.pass_status
          label: Pass Status
          description: Pass, fail, reworked, or hold.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/6
    - id: fab_tool
      label: Fab Tool
      description: A governed piece of fabrication equipment such as a stepper, etcher, or CMP polisher.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3
      properties:
        - id: fab_tool.tool_id
          label: Tool Id
          description: Stable tool identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/0
        - id: fab_tool.tool_type
          label: Tool Type
          description: Stepper, scanner, etcher, CMP, CVD, PVD, implant, metrology.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/1
        - id: fab_tool.vendor
          label: Vendor
          description: Equipment vendor such as ASML, AMAT, LAM, TEL.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/2
        - id: fab_tool.model
          label: Model
          description: Vendor model identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/3
        - id: fab_tool.operational_status
          label: Operational Status
          description: In service, down, maintenance, qualification.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/4
    - id: yield_measurement
      label: Yield Measurement
      description: A governed measurement of die or wafer yield.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4
      properties:
        - id: yield_measurement.measurement_id
          label: Measurement Id
          description: Stable yield measurement identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/0
        - id: yield_measurement.measurement_date
          label: Measurement Date
          description: Date of measurement.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/1
        - id: yield_measurement.dies_passed
          label: Dies Passed
          description: Number of passing dies.
          dataType: integer
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/2
        - id: yield_measurement.dies_total
          label: Dies Total
          description: Total dies measured.
          dataType: integer
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/3
        - id: yield_measurement.yield_pct
          label: Yield Pct
          description: Yield percentage.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/4
        - id: yield_measurement.bin_summary
          label: Bin Summary
          description: Distribution of test bin outcomes.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/5
    - id: defect_event
      label: Defect Event
      description: A governed defect found on a wafer, lot, or die.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5
      properties:
        - id: defect_event.defect_id
          label: Defect Id
          description: Stable defect identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/0
        - id: defect_event.defect_type
          label: Defect Type
          description: Particle, scratch, void, pattern, contamination, etc.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/1
        - id: defect_event.detected_at
          label: Detected At
          description: Time of detection.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/2
        - id: defect_event.severity
          label: Severity
          description: Critical, major, minor.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/3
        - id: defect_event.root_cause
          label: Root Cause
          description: Identified root cause if known.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/4
        - id: defect_event.source_tool
          label: Source Tool
          description: Suspected tool of origin.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/5
    # Shared core types
    - id: person
      label: Person
      description: A human being identified in a governed business context.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6
      properties:
        - id: person.person_id
          label: Person identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the person.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/0
        - id: person.display_name
          label: Display name
          description: Preferred name used in governed interfaces.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/1
        - id: person.effective_from
          label: Effective from
          description: Time from which this person record is valid.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/2
    - id: organization
      label: Organization
      description: A governed legal, public, or operating organization.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7
      properties:
        - id: organization.organization_id
          label: Organization identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the organization.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/0
        - id: organization.legal_name
          label: Legal name
          description: Registered or otherwise authoritative organization name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/1
        - id: organization.organization_type
          label: Organization type
          description: Governed classification of the organization.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/2
    - id: agent
      label: Agent
      description: A human or software actor authorized to perform governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8
      properties:
        - id: agent.agent_id
          label: Agent identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the actor.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/0
        - id: agent.agent_type
          label: Agent type
          description: Whether the actor is human, service, or automated.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/1
        - id: agent.active
          label: Active
          description: Whether the agent is currently authorized.
          dataType: boolean
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/2
    - id: location
      label: Location
      description: A physical, administrative, or virtual place relevant to governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9
      properties:
        - id: location.location_id
          label: Location identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the location.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/0
        - id: location.name
          label: Location name
          description: Human-readable location name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/1
        - id: location.country_code
          label: Country code
          description: ISO country code when applicable.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/2
    - id: document
      label: Document
      description: A governed information artifact with identity, version, and provenance.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10
      properties:
        - id: document.document_id
          label: Document identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the document.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/0
        - id: document.title
          label: Title
          description: Authoritative document title.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/1
        - id: document.version
          label: Version
          description: Document version or revision.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/2
        - id: document.issued_at
          label: Issued at
          description: Time at which the document was issued.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/3
    - id: event
      label: Event
      description: A governed occurrence bounded by time and business meaning.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11
      properties:
        - id: event.event_id
          label: Event identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/0
        - id: event.event_type
          label: Event type
          description: Governed classification of the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/1
        - id: event.occurred_at
          label: Occurred at
          description: Time at which the event occurred.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/2
    - id: asset
      label: Asset
      description: A governed physical, digital, or financial resource.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12
      properties:
        - id: asset.asset_id
          label: Asset identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the asset.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/0
        - id: asset.name
          label: Asset name
          description: Human-readable asset name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/1
        - id: asset.asset_type
          label: Asset type
          description: Governed classification of the asset.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/2
    - id: policy
      label: Policy
      description: A versioned rule or standard governing decisions and actions.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13
      properties:
        - id: policy.policy_id
          label: Policy identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the policy.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/0
        - id: policy.title
          label: Policy title
          description: Authoritative policy title.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/1
        - id: policy.version
          label: Version
          description: Approved policy version.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/2
        - id: policy.effective_from
          label: Effective from
          description: Time from which the policy applies.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/3
  relationships:
    - id: wafer_belongs_to_lot
      label: BELONGS_TO_LOT
      description: Wafer belongs to a lot.
      sourceTypeId: wafer
      targetTypeId: lot
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/0
    - id: process_step_processes_wafer
      label: PROCESSES_WAFER
      description: Process step acts on a wafer.
      sourceTypeId: process_step
      targetTypeId: wafer
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/1
    - id: process_step_executed_by_tool
      label: EXECUTED_BY_TOOL
      description: Process step executed by a fab tool.
      sourceTypeId: process_step
      targetTypeId: fab_tool
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/2
    - id: yield_measurement_measures_wafer
      label: MEASURES_WAFER
      description: Yield measurement measures a wafer.
      sourceTypeId: yield_measurement
      targetTypeId: wafer
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/3
    - id: defect_event_on_wafer
      label: DEFECT_ON_WAFER
      description: Defect event located on a wafer.
      sourceTypeId: defect_event
      targetTypeId: wafer
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/4
    - id: defect_event_attributed_to_tool
      label: ATTRIBUTED_TO_TOOL
      description: Defect event attributed to a tool.
      sourceTypeId: defect_event
      targetTypeId: fab_tool
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/5
    - id: member_of
      label: MEMBER_OF
      description: A person is affiliated with an organization.
      sourceTypeId: person
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/6
    - id: acts_for
      label: ACTS_FOR
      description: An agent acts on behalf of an organization.
      sourceTypeId: agent
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/7
    - id: located_at
      label: LOCATED_AT
      description: An organization operates at a location.
      sourceTypeId: organization
      targetTypeId: location
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/8
    - id: documents
      label: DOCUMENTS
      description: A document records or describes an event.
      sourceTypeId: document
      targetTypeId: event
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/9
    - id: involves_asset
      label: INVOLVES_ASSET
      description: An event involves a governed asset.
      sourceTypeId: event
      targetTypeId: asset
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/10
    - id: governed_by_policy
      label: GOVERNED_BY_POLICY
      description: An event is governed by an applicable policy.
      sourceTypeId: event
      targetTypeId: policy
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/11
    - id: owned_by_organization
      label: OWNED_BY_ORGANIZATION
      description: An asset is owned or stewarded by an organization.
      sourceTypeId: asset
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/12
